I suggest we all contribute 10 tokens each round to start, which would give each of us a return of (10*5)*1.6/5 = 16 tokens from the pool, plus keeping 10 of our endowment, for a total of 26 tokens each. This is better than keeping all 20 (which would give 20). Let's see if we can coordinate.
